findings.claim: FTC 對 Synopsys／Ansys 合併要求依同意令剝離資產（光學、光子、RTL 功耗分析三市場），資產交 Keysight；德文報導稱最終令於 2025-10-17 定案，FTC 頁面仍標 Pending
findings.source: FTC: synopsis inc ansys inc matter
findings.excerpt: The Federal Trade Commission will require Synopsys, Inc. and Ansys, Inc., under a proposed consent order, to divest certain assets to resolve antitrust concerns surrounding their $35 billion merger.

findings.claim: 歐盟執委會 2025 年 1 月附剝離條件核准 Synopsys 收購 Ansys；英國 CMA 同樣以剝離方案達成結果
findings.source: TechCrunch: EU approves $35B Synopsys and Ansys merger subject to divestment conditions
